This guide is a simplified overview of all the changes in the [[Bedrock Edition]] 0.12.x releases, which assumes at least some familiarity with 0.11.x releases.

== Creature ==
=== NEW CONTENT ===
{|{{Simple Guide table|New Mobs}}
|-
|[[Iron Golem]]
|[[File:Iron Golem JE1 BE1.png|128px]]
|
* {{EnvLink|Village}}
* Can be generated by placing 4 [[Iron Blocks]] and 1 [[Pumpkin]] in a certain order.
|

{{Drop|Block|Poppy|0|2}}
|
|-
|[[Snow Golem]]
|{{Animate|Snow Golem JE1 BE1.png; Sheared Snow Golem JE1 BE1.png|128px}}
|
* Can be generated by placing 2 [[Snow]] blocks and 1 pumpkin in a certain order.
|
{{Drop|Item|Snowball|0|15}}
|
|-
|[[Ocelot]]
|[[File:Ocelot JE1 BE1.png|128px]]

* {{BiomeLink|Jungle}} and its variants
|
|
* Can be tamed with raw fish.
|-
|[[Zombie Villager]]
|{{Animate|Zombie Farmer.png; Zombie Librarian.png; Zombie Priest.png; Zombie Blacksmith.png; Zombie Butcher.png; Zombie Nitwit.png|128px}}
{{Animate|Baby Zombie Farmer.png; Baby Zombie Librarian.png; Baby Zombie Priest.png; Baby Zombie Blacksmith.png; Baby Zombie Butcher.png; Baby Zombie Nitwit.png|64px}}
|
* [[Zombies]] that are naturally generated or spawned by [[Monster Spawners]] have a 5% chance of becoming zombie villagers.
* When zombies and their variants kill a [[villager]], the villager will have a chance to become a zombie villager.
|
{{Drop|Item|Rotten Flesh|0|2}}
{{Drop|Item|Iron Ingot|0|1}}
{{Drop|Item|Carrot|0|1}}
{{Drop|Item|Potato|0|1}}
|
* Villagers still retain their clothes and professions after being infected by zombies.

|

|
{{Drop|Item|Gunpowder|0|2}}
{{Drop|Block|Creeper Head|When killed by a Charged Creeper}}
|

=== Changes ===
{|{{Simple Guide table|Changed Mobs}}
|-
|General
|
|
* Burning creatures will make a "hissing" sound when the fire on them is extinguished.
* Mobs drop experience orbs when they die.
* Improved AI.
** Improved pathfinding within fences.
** Will seek water and seek shade when on fire.
** Now avoids lava.
|-
|[[zombie]]
|[[File:Zombie JE1 BE1.png|128px]]
[[File:Baby Zombie JE1 BE1.png|64px]]
|
* Zombies can wear armor or pick up items.
* Zombies have a chance to drop armor and weapons, but the probability is very small.
* Now able to destroy doors.
* A Charged Creeper will drop its head when killed.
* Players can now be spotted from 40 meters away.
* Now drops [[Iron Ingots]].
|-
|[[Skeleton]]
|[[File:Skeleton JE4 BE2.png|128px]]
|
* Skeletons can put on armor or pick up items.
* Archery accuracy improved.
* Skeletons have a chance to drop armor and weapons, but the probability is very small.
* The skeletons generated in the Nether are [[Wither Skeletons]].
* A Charged Creeper will drop its head when killed.
* The sound of death becomes the same as Java version.
|-
|[[Creeper]]
|[[File:Creeper JE2 BE1.png|128px]]
|
* Creepers are generated after being hit by lightning during thunderstorms.
* A Charged Creeper will drop its head when killed.
* Stay away from [[Ocelot]] (both wild and tamed varieties).
|-
|[[Enderman]]
|[[File:Enderman BE1.png|128px]]
|
* Now avoids water.
|-
|[[Slime]]
|[[File:Slime JE3 BE1.png|128px]]
|
* Small particles (visual effects) will be generated when slimes jump.
* Now drops [[Slimeball]]s.
|-
|[[Magma Cube]]
|[[File:Magma Cube JE1 BE1.png|128px]]
|
* Now generates properly in the Nether.
* Drops [[Magma Cream]] when killed.
* Added particle effects when jumping.
|-
|[[Zombie Pigman]]
|[[File:Zombified Piglin JE3 BE2.png|128px]]
[[File:Baby Zombified Piglin JE2 BE1.png|64px]]
|
* Zombie pigmen have become conditionally hostile.
* Zombie pigmen will spawn in the Nether.
* Can put on armor or pick up items.
* There is now a chance to drop armor and weapons, but the probability is very small.
* Now drops [[Gold Nuggets]].
* There is a chance to spawn with an enchanted sword.
|-
|[[Villager]]
|{{Animate|Farmer.png; Librarian.png; Priest.png; Blacksmith.png; Butcher.png; Nitwit.png|128px}}
|
* Now has the ability to open and close doors.
* Can now harvest crops.
* Can now be bred.
* When attacked by a player, angry particle effects will appear.
* Killing by a zombie on Hard difficulty now always results in a zombie villager.
** [[Zombie Villagers]] can be healed with [[Splash Potion]] and [[Golden Apples]] of weakness.
|-
|[[Spider]]
|[[File:Spider JE3 BE2.png|128px]]
|
* There were footsteps.
* Now drops Spider Eyes.
|-
|[[Ghast]]
|[[File:Ghast JE1 BE1.gif|128px]]
|
* Now generates in the Nether.
* Now drops [[Ghast Tear]]s.
* Now makes a sound.
* Increased hitbox size.
|-
|[[Pig]]
|[[File:Pig JE2 BE1.png|128px]]
[[File:Baby Pig JE1 BE1.png|64px]]
|
* Will now turn into zombie pigmen after being struck by lightning during thunderstorms.
|-
|[[Wolf]]
|[[File:Tamed Wolf with Red Collar.png|128px]]
[[File:Baby Tamed Wolf.png|64px]]
|
* Tamed wolves will now attack the target after being attacked by a bow.
|-
|[[silverfish]]
|[[File:Silverfish.gif|128px]]
|
* No more noise when walking.
|}

|
* [[Wither Skeleton]] has a 2.5% chance of dropping a Wither Skeleton head when killed by a player or a tamed wolf. Each level of [[Looting]] enchantment can increase the drop probability by 1%, up to 5.5% of Looting III.
* [[Skeleton]], [[Wither Skeleton]], [[Zombie]] and [[Creeper]] will also drop corresponding creature heads when killed by a [[Charged Creeper]].
* Player heads cannot be obtained as drops.
|
* Can be broken with any tool and drop itself.

* decorate.

=== Changes ===
{|{{Simple Guide table|Changed Blocks}}
|-
|[[Nether Reactor Core]]
|{{Animate|Nether Reactor Core BE1.png; Initialized Nether Reactor Core BE1.png; Finished Nether Reactor Core BE1.png|84px}}
|
* Cannot be crafted.
* Removed from crafting menu and creative mode inventory.
* Still drops when broken (3 diamonds and 6 iron ingots).
* Can only be obtained by editing the inventory.
* No longer functional.
|-
|[[furnace]]
|{{Animate|Furnace JE2 BE1.png; Lit Furnace JE2 BE1.png|84px}}
|
* Center the names of smelted items.
|-
|[[Snow]]
|{{Animate|Snow (layers 1) JE2 BE2.png; Snow (layers 2) JE2 BE1.png; Snow (layers 3) JE2 BE1.png; Snow (layers 4) JE2 BE1.png; Snow (layers 5) JE2 BE1.png; Snow (layers 6) JE2 BE1.png; Snow (layers 7) JE2 BE1.png; Snow Block JE1 BE1.png|84px}}
|
* {{ve}}Snow usually forms in multiple layers during snowfall.
* {{ve}}Snow is affected by gravity.
|-
|[[Crops]]
|
|
* Destroying crops will always drop seeds.
|-
|[[Lava]]
|[[File:Lava BE2.gif|84px]]
|
* {{ve}} is brighter.
* Now prevents mobs from taking fall damage.
* In the Nether, flow is the same as in Java Edition, with a radius of 8 blocks.
|-
|[[Water]]
|{{Animate|Water JE2 BE2.png; Swamp Water BE1.png|84px}}
|
* Improved the effect of climbing up water while leaning against a wall.
*Breaking blocks underwater is harder.
|-
|[[door]]
|[[File:Oak Door JE4 BE3.png|84px]]
|
* Can be stacked up to 64 pieces.
* 6 wooden boards can be combined into 3 doors.
|-
|[[ice floe]]
|[[File:Packed Ice JE1 BE2.png|84px]]
|
* Got new textures.
|-
|[[quartz column]]
|{{Animate|Quartz Pillar Axis X Revision 1.png; Quartz Pillar Axis Z Revision 1.png|84px}}
|
* Can now be placed horizontally.
|-
|[[Withered Bush]]
|[[File:Dead Bush JE1 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* When destroyed without scissors, 0-2 [[Wooden Sticks]] will be dropped when destroyed anywhere.
|-
|[[End portal frame]]
|{{Animate|End Portal Frame (S) JE2 BE1.png; Filled End Portal Frame (S) JE2 BE1.png|84px}}
|
* Will face the player when placed.
|-
|[[Trapdoor]]
|[[File:Oak Trapdoor JE1 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Can be placed on the top or bottom of the block.
|-
|[[ladder]]
|[[File:Ladder (S) JE2 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Can now be placed while sneaking.
|}

=== Changes ===
{|{{Simple Guide table|Changed Items}}
|-
|[[ship]]
|{{Animate|Oak Boat (item) JE3 BE2.png; Birch Boat (item) JE1 BE2.png; Spruce Boat (item) JE1 BE2.png; Jungle Boat (item) JE1 BE2.png; Acacia Boat (item) JE1 BE2.png; Dark Oak Boat (item) JE1 BE2.png|84px}}
|
* A new icon has been designed for the item ship.
* Now includes the item [[paddle]].
* Boats made of different wood plank textures come in different colors.
|-
|[[Food]]
|
|
* Players who eat food will restore their hunger points, but their health points will not be restored immediately.
|-
|[[Pufferfish (item)|Pufferfish]]
|[[File:Pufferfish JE2 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Now creates the following status effects
** {{EffectLink|Poison}} IV (1:00)
** {{EffectLink|Hunger}} III (0:15)
** {{EffectLink|Nausea}} (0:15)
|-
|[[Rotten Flesh]]
|[[File:Rotten Flesh JE1 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Due to the addition of hunger, they now give the player the status effect {{EffectLink|Hunger}} instead of {{EffectLink|Poison}} in [[Pocket Edition Alpha 0.11.0|0.11.0]].
|-
|[[Beetroot]]
|[[File:Beetroot JE1 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Beet seeds can now be obtained from village farms.
* Beet seeds can no longer be obtained by hoeing.
|-
|[[seed]]
|
|
* Seeds can no longer be obtained by hoeing.
|-
|[[Book]]
|[[File:Book JE1 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Now crafted using leather.
|-
|[[Spawn Egg]]
|
|
* Creatures spawned from renamed monster eggs will have the same name as the spawn egg, and their names will appear in the death message after death.
* Zombie spawn eggs now have a chance to spawn zombie villagers.
|-
|[[Sword]]
|{{Animate|Wooden Sword JE1 BE1.png; Golden Sword JE2 BE1.png; Stone Sword JE1 BE1.png; Iron Sword JE1 BE1.png; Diamond Sword JE1 BE1.png|84px}}
|
* Can no longer be used to break blocks in creative mode.
|-
|[[Magma Cream]]
|[[File:Magma Cream JE1 BE1.png|84px]]
|
* Can now be crafted.
|}

|
* Eating no longer directly restores [[HP]].

|
* Added rain, snow and thunderstorm weather.
|-
|[[Sprint]]
|
* Activate by double-clicking the arrow keys.
|-
|[[Stealth]]
|
* A new sneak button is added to switch the stealth state. Before this, an Xperia PLAY device was needed to switch.
|-
|[[Brewing]]
|
* Added a complete brewing system.
|-
|[[Difficulty]]
|
* Peaceful, Easy, Normal, Hard
|-
|[[Item Repair]]
|
* Use [[Anvil]] to perform.
|-
|Animation
|
* Added animation when switching items in the shortcut bar.

=== Changes ===
{| class = "wikitable"
! Name !! Change
|-
|[[Control]]
|
* Flight controls are now slightly smaller.
* Slight delay when jumping in tight spaces.
* Players can now place blocks underneath them while sneaking.
* Hand movement animation will be shown every time a block is clicked, not just when placing the block.
|-
|[[Chat]]
